name: QAH Git Marketplace
description: Plugins for Quantum Analysis Helper, stored in Git.

plugins.name: Git Plugin Marketplace
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Discover, install, update, publish and delete QAH plugins, themes and sandboxed Sentinel addons using a Git repository (GitHub) instead of Firebase. Includes a hard self-update guard.

versions.changelog: Git Plugin Marketplace 1.0.0: public catalog defaults and pull-request contribution workflow.
Automatic pull-request submission: fork, branch, commit and open a PR from the GUI or CLI.
Automatic pull-request submission plus fork sync for older forks.
Git Plugin Marketplace 1.1.2: fixes a QThread cleanup race that could close QAH with a Qt fatal error after publishing a plugin; publish refresh is now deferred until the worker finishes.
Git Plugin Marketplace 1.1.3: adds Install version selection for older releases replacing the current user copy; protects system/wheel plugins from marketplace update, shadowing and Update all.

Git Plugin Marketplace 1.1.4: first-class theme assets (catalog themes section, .qtheme.zip install/update/uninstall, Theme Manager refresh), theme CLI commands, and safe Reload now / Restart later after plugin install. Old catalogs without themes remain compatible.

Git Plugin Marketplace 1.2.0: adds Sentinel addon assets (catalog, Addons filter, .qah install/update/uninstall/publish), addon hash pinning integration, Update all for plugins/themes/addons, and a hard self-update guard that blocks the marketplace from replacing or removing itself while running.

plugins.name: LuaQAH Studio
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: A professional visual programming studio for Lua inside QAH: typed blocks, connection-aware code generation, undo/redo, syntax-highlighted preview and an interactive Lua terminal.

plugins.name: Plugin Health Guard
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Headless startup health check for QAH plugins: manifest integrity, missing entry points, duplicate ids, backup files and stale bytecode, with a JSON report, read-only API and menu actions.

versions.changelog: Initial Plugin Health Guard release: a headless startup plugin health check. No widget; writes a JSON report and provides Run health check / Open report menu actions. Checks manifests, missing entry points, duplicate ids, backup files and stale bytecode.
Plugin Health Guard 1.0.1: adds a read-only health_api for other plugins and reports consumed by Plugin Sentinel's Health tab.

plugins.name: Plugin Sentinel
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Advanced plugin security audit: risk scoring, capability mapping, native DLL/SO/dylib inspection, trusted baselines, hash watchdog, public watchdog API, installable watchdog builder, sandboxed Sentinel addons with hash pinning, process sandbox, runtime monitor with plugin-execution control, policy gates, Health Guard integration, reports and CI-friendly CLI.

versions.changelog: Initial Plugin Sentinel release: advanced plugin security audit with risk scoring, capability mapping, native PE/ELF/Mach-O inspection, recursive user-plugin discovery, trusted baselines, hash watchdog, process sandbox, live runtime monitor, policy gates, reports and CLI.

Plugin Sentinel 1.1.0: adds public watchdog API for other plugins (watch plugin/library/execution paths, callbacks, poll), a Documentation tab, recursive user-plugin discovery, native inspection, runtime monitor, hash watchdog and process sandbox.

Plugin Sentinel 1.1.1: Runtime Plugin Executions subtab can unload selected user plugins (system/wheel protected), Health tab reads Plugin Health Guard reports, sandbox blocks sensitive credential reads/registry/process creation and adds Windows CPU limits.

Plugin Sentinel 1.1.2: fixes Plugin Executions manager discovery, adds Watchdog Builder that generates installable headless watchdog plugins, and keeps Health Guard integration and sandbox improvements.

Plugin Sentinel 1.2.0: adds the Addons tab and sandboxed addon runtime (.qah source packages, addon.json API v1, hash pinning, capability checks, isolated addon_host with audit hooks, timeouts and memory limits), marketplace addon install integration, and Addon Studio test support via run_addon_folder.

plugins.name: QAH SSH
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Enhanced Cluster Connector with folder upload/download, background queued transfers and deletes, server-side compressed downloads, command auto-complete, custom icon, temporal files and credential history

versions.changelog: QAH SSH 3.7.0: server-side tar.gz compression for batch downloads, safe local extraction, automatic remote temp cleanup, compressed context-menu action and backup-file exclusion.
QAH SSH 3.8.0: custom SSH terminal icon plus command auto-complete from history, built-in HPC commands and remote compgen suggestions.

QAH SSH 3.8.1: fixes Credential Manager 'Use in Form'. Saved credentials now store the encrypted password token in the credential index, so the form is filled even if shh_info_history.json is missing. Legacy entries fill host/port/user and prompt for the password once.

QAH SSH 3.9.0: adds a sequential transfer queue for uploads, folder uploads, normal downloads and compressed tar.gz downloads, with pause/resume, cancel current, clear finished and per-job status. Existing Upload/Download buttons keep their immediate behaviour.

QAH SSH 3.9.1: moves the Transfer Queue out of the file browser into its own main tab, next to SSH Browser, Text Editor and Temporary Files. Queue behaviour and existing immediate upload/download buttons are unchanged.
QAH SSH 3.9.2: places all Transfer Queue buttons on one row and shortens the control labels to Pause, Cancel and Clear. Queue behaviour is unchanged.

QAH SSH 3.9.3: adds a Queue transfers checkbox. When checked, the main Upload File, Upload Folder and Download buttons add jobs to the Transfer Queue tab; unchecked keeps the original immediate behaviour.

QAH SSH 3.10.0: queued transfers now run in a background worker with their own SFTP channel, so SSH Browser navigation, refresh and other tabs stay responsive during an upload or download. Queue remains sequential; immediate transfers are unchanged.
QAH SSH 3.11.0: Transfer Queue is now control-only: Pause/Resume, Stop current, Stop all, Retry selected and Clear finished. Add jobs from SSH Browser with the Queue transfers checkbox.
QAH SSH 3.11.1: Queue transfers is now checked by default, so uploads and downloads run in the background queue. Compressed downloads always use the background queue even when the checkbox is off.

QAH SSH 3.11.3: keeps Transfer Queue as the second tab and makes Edit in Text Editor / Temporary Files select the Text Editor widget directly, so the correct tab is always focused regardless of tab order.
QAH SSH 3.11.4: moves Queue transfers and Compress on server to a second options row so the terminal is not squeezed, and wraps the whole plugin UI in a scroll area for small screens.

QAH SSH 3.12.0: deletes can now run in the background transfer queue (respecting the Queue transfers checkbox), and removes the redundant Edit in Text Editor toolbar button. Edit remains in the context menu and Ctrl+E.

plugins.name: QAH WS Client
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Encrypted WSS remote command console for QAH: connect to a paired QAH WS Server, run commands and receive live stdout/stderr and exit codes.

versions.changelog: QAH WS Client 1.0.0: encrypted WSS connection, one-time invite pairing, password unlock for permanent auto-approve, live stdout/stderr and cancel.
QAH WS Client 1.0.1: default working directory is the server user's home, plus an optional working-dir field.

QAH WS Client 1.2.0: adds relay transport support, a Relay tab showing relay/room/token imported from invites, and an offline Documentation tab covering Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, relay mode, security and troubleshooting. Direct invites and old client settings remain compatible.

plugins.name: QAH WS Server
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Encrypted WSS remote command console for QAH: paired clients run commands and receive streamed stdout/stderr, with timed or password-protected permanent auto-approve.

versions.changelog: QAH WS Server 1.0.0: encrypted WSS remote command console with pairing, timed and password-protected permanent auto-approve, destructive-command guard and audit log.
QAH WS Server 1.0.1: fall back to the server user's home when a client sends a missing working directory.

QAH WS Server 1.2.0: adds outbound relay mode (bundled relay_server.py), a Relay tab, and an offline Documentation tab covering Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, relay mode, security and troubleshooting. Direct mode remains the default and old settings keep working.

plugins.name: Runtime Forge
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Isolated per-plugin Python runtimes: hash-pinned wheel lock files, per-plugin site-packages, JSON-RPC runtime host, rollback, Sentinel integration, UI and CLI.

versions.changelog: Initial Runtime Forge release: isolated per-plugin Python site-packages, hash-locked wheel installs, JSON-RPC runtime host, rollback, Sentinel integration, UI and CLI. Wheels only; no pip/setup.py/cargo on the user machine.

plugins.name: Secure Share
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Encrypted text, file and folder exchange between QAH computers over the LAN or through a private Git relay, with per-device key pairing.

versions.changelog: Secure Share 1.0.0: encrypted text, file and folder exchange over LAN or a private Git relay, with per-device pairing and a PDF user guide.
Secure Share 1.0.1: store peer LAN addresses, TCP reachability probe for the online indicator, direct-address fallback and manual Set address action; updated PDF guide.

plugins.name: SQS Generator
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Generate Special Quasirandom Structures (SQS) for binary alloys following Zunger (1990) and van de Walle (2013) methods

plugins.name: Theme Studio
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Advanced theme builder for QAH: live preview, token editor, generated QSS, legacy theme.json + CSS export, .qtheme.zip packages and Git Marketplace publishing.

versions.changelog: Initial Theme Studio release: visual token editor, generated QSS, live preview, legacy-compatible theme.json + theme.css export, .qtheme.zip packaging, import and Git Marketplace publishing.

plugins.name: Wheel Plugin Manager
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Install, validate, repair, test, build and remove QAH wheel plugins without python.exe. Windows-safe: unpacks wheels directly and rejects malformed builds whose entry point could never be imported.

versions.changelog: Initial release: Windows-safe wheel installation without python.exe, wheel validation, fix/repair builds, cross-platform paths.

themes.name: Studio Aurora
themes.author: Acxel Orozco
themes.description: Aurora-inspired theme with teal accents and a deep navy surface.

versions.changelog: Initial Studio Aurora theme: deep navy surfaces, teal accents and legacy-compatible theme.json + theme.css.
